purpose: Selection record for two-column pairing in the FP32 four-row (prefill) path

baseline.description: Merged oct remainder rows plus four-position attend scoring (PR #62)

candidate.description: Four-row path pairs two output columns per iteration: each four-row input bundle serves eight accumulators (4 rows x 2 columns). Per-output ascending-index accumulation order unchanged; remainder rows keep the oct loop. A 4-column x 4-row variant (16 accumulators) was skipped because the sixteen-accumulator step is already measured slower.

kernel_results.median_ratio_summary: Paired-column vs baseline across three fresh processes: workers1 ~0.54-0.62 on rows>=4 shapes, workers4 ~0.55-0.76; five-row mixed ~0.66-0.68. Identical outputs at every step.

generation_results.median_ratio_summary: Synthetic FP32 fixture, 64 paired trials x 3 processes: prefix129/outputs1 ~0.748, prefix257/outputs1 ~0.753-0.757 (long-prefill cases finally move), prefix33/outputs8 ~0.81-0.83, outputs128 ~0.97, tiny prefix ~1.00. Every completion matched.

real_model.model: Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct, f32, greedy, threads=4, ~330-token prompt, 8 tokens

limitations: Single model/host; no quantized, other-platform, or tail-latency claims
Prefill share depends on prompt length; decode-dominated workloads see smaller gains
